game.title: Battlefield 6
game.blurb: Modern military first-person shooter with a single-player campaign and all-out multiplayer, from Battlefield Studios, released 2025-10-10. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Campaign: Opening Missions
chapters.summary: Always Faithful, The Rock, Operation Gladius and Night Raid.

chapters.title: Campaign: Later Missions and Finale
chapters.summary: No Sleep, Moving Mountains, Nile Guard, Operation Ember Strike and the end of the campaign. Hidden achievements sit here too.

chapters.title: Campaign Collectibles
chapters.summary: Picking up the collectibles hidden through the campaign missions.

chapters.title: Campaign Difficulty and Combat
chapters.summary: The hardest difficulty, headshots, grenades and vehicle kills in single player.

chapters.title: Multiplayer Modes
chapters.summary: Conquest objectives, Breakthrough sectors and M-COM charges.

chapters.title: Multiplayer Classes and Combat
chapters.summary: Assault, Recon and Support goals, vehicles, sidearms, LMGs, takedowns and acts of valor.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is "battlefield-6-2" (id 1007483), the 2025 game; RAWG's plain "battlefield-6" slug is Battlefield 2042. No StrategyWiki page under "Battlefield 6" or "Battlefield VI". battlefield.fandom.com answers the API with about 411 linked articles (weapons, vehicles, characters and maps such as "Always Faithful" and "Always Forward"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Glacier" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 2807960 as "Battlefield™ 6". 20 of 53 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the later campaign chapter as a placeholder, but some (for example "Collector" at 33%, and "Army of Two" or "Never-Ending Game") may well be multiplayer goals. The campaign is split at the mission order of the Steam list and its falling unlock rates. "A Little C-4 Knocking on Your Door" (Demolition Charge damage) does not say which mode it belongs to; it sits in the multiplayer combat chapter. Multiplayer chapters need online play.
